header.sub: These details appear in the header of your digital prescriptions. Keep them current — patients and pharmacies see this information.
header.subUnregulated: These details appear on your public profile and in your communications with patients (emails, bookings, receipts). Keep them current — your patients see this information.

plano.trialExpiresOn: Expires on {{date}}. Subscribe before to keep access.
plano.pendingSub: Trial active until the review. We'll email you within 48h.
plano.recemEligTrialOver: Trial ended. Subscribe to continue using.
plano.blockedSub: Your clinical features (creating sessions, prescriptions, documents, patients) are suspended until you subscribe.

ident.rqeHint: Required for psychiatrists and other registered specialists (CFM 1.701/2003).
ident.cnpj: CNPJ (optional, if operating as a company)

address.sub: Shown in prescription headers. Use the physical practice address, even if you only see patients online.

photo.sub: Appears at the top of the dashboard (circular avatar) and in communications with patients. PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB — we resize to 256×256 before saving.

logo.sub: PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 200 KB. Appears in the top corner of prescription PDFs. For best quality, use a square aspect ratio (e.g.: 240×240).

sched.sub: Share a public link for patients to request a time directly. You approve or decline each request from the dashboard — nothing is confirmed automatically.
sched.slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (3-40 characters). e.g.: dr-roberto-fernandes.
sched.minNoticeHint: How long before patients must book. Default 24h.
sched.maxAdvanceHint: How many days ahead requests are accepted. Default 60.
sched.listToggleHtml: Appear in the public directory (patients can find you)
sched.listSub: The directory lists only verified practitioners with active scheduling. You can opt out anytime.

asaas.subHtml: Connect your Asaas account to generate Pix directly from finance entries. Funds settle into your account — Espaço Prelúdio only orchestrates the call (we are not a financial intermediary).
asaas.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current one
asaas.apiKeyHint: Asaas panel → Integrations → API. Sandbox and production have different keys. Your key stays server-side and is never returned by /me.
asaas.enabledToggle: Enable online charges ("Charge via Pix" button appears in finances)

push.sub: Get instant browser alerts when: a patient requests a slot via your public link OR fills in an intake form. Works even with the tab closed (if the browser is running).
push.unsupported: Your browser does not support push notifications.
push.permDenied: Permission denied in browser settings. Clear the block and reload.
push.swUnavailable: Service Worker not available in this browser.
push.notEnabled: Not enabled on this device. Click to activate.
push.permNotGranted: Permission not granted. Check your browser settings.
push.serverNotReady: Push server is not configured yet. Try in a few minutes.

nfse.subHtml: Issue NFS-e via NFE.io — covers all of Brazil's ~5,500 municipalities. Configure your company once in the NFE.io panel and paste the token here.
nfse.stepsHtml:
• Create an account at app.nfe.io and register your company (CNPJ, municipal registration, A1 certificate).
  • In the NFE.io panel go to Settings → API and generate an API Token.
  • Take note of the Company ID (the company UUID — appears in the panel URL).
  • Paste both below + fill in your city's municipal service code and ISS rate.
  • Save. Done — the "Issue NFS-e" button appears on paid receipts.
nfse.apiTokenPlaceholder: Bearer token generated in the panel
nfse.cnaeHintHtml: Check with your city hall. Florianópolis psychology: 04231.
nfse.costNoteHtml: Cost: NFE.io charges ~R$ 0.15-0.40 per invoice. You pay them directly. Their plan, their billing — we only relay the issuance.

clinic.sub: Invite other practitioners to see patients via your clinic with an automatic payout rule. Each member keeps an individual Espaço Prelúdio account (R$ 199/month each) — the payout simply splits revenue from sessions marked as "via clinic".
clinic.name: Clinic name *

sms.subHtml: Send reminders via SMS in addition to email + WhatsApp. Useful for patients without WhatsApp. Provider: Twilio — you pay them directly (~R$ 0.04 per SMS to Brazil). Create an account, enable SMS Brazil, copy credentials.
sms.authTokenPlaceholder: (leave blank to keep the current one)
sms.fromNumberHint: Twilio number approved for Brazil. Twilio Console → Phone Numbers.

tiss.sub: Register the insurance plans you accept for TISS billing (Brazilian supplementary-health data exchange). Each patient can then have their card linked, and their sessions can be flagged as "via insurance".
tiss.codeHint: Short slug. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
tiss.phaseNoteHtml:
Phase 1 (current): register insurance plans + cards + flag session "via insurance" + status (paid/denied).
Phase 2: generate TISS 4.01.00 XML to export and submit manually in the insurer's portal.
Phase 3+: auto-submit via API per insurer.

lgpd.sub: Right to data portability (LGPD Art. 18 — Brazil's data protection law): you can download a ZIP file with EVERY piece of data we hold about you and your patients — decrypted patients, sessions, notes, finances, receipts, prescriptions, documents, intakes, audit. E2E-encrypted items are decrypted in your browser before packaging.
lgpd.backupTitle: Downloads an .epbk file with your data still encrypted — only you (with your password) can open it.
lgpd.deleteAccountHtml: To delete your account: contact support. The process is manual (per CFP/CFM requirements on retention of clinical records).

twofa.sub: Extra security layer: beyond your password, we ask for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password) on every new login.
twofa.setupSub: Open the authenticator app on your phone and scan the QR code. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
twofa.disableSub: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to confirm it's you disabling.
